$comment: The DELETION TRIPWIRE for the governed example set (FEL-426).
scripts/build-governed-examples.ts derives what to run by scanning examples/
for coverage.manifest.json. That is the right default — add a manifest and the
lane covers it, with no central list to keep in sync. But a set defined purely
by what is on disk cannot notice something LEAVING disk: delete an example and
the lane simply stops mentioning it and passes green. Coverage shrinks in
silence, which is the same shape of bug as the one this file was created for.
So: enumeration stays derived, and this is only a FLOOR. Adding a governed
example still requires nothing here. REMOVING one requires deleting its line
here too — a deliberate, reviewable act in the diff, instead of a coverage
If a name below has no coverage.manifest.json on disk, the lane fails.
